latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – agent-powered bicycle maintenance for gig-workers and daily commuters.

- Personalized maintenance calendar based on your mileage, bike specs, and local conditions.
- Step-by-step decision-tree diagnostics for common issues (flats, shifting, brakes, wobble) with escalation triggers.
- Automatic parts sourcing with shopping lists, retailer links, and inventory tracking.
- Filesystem-based logging of service history, reminders, and next scheduled service.
- Checklists, repair protocols, and workspace setup guidance—empowering you to do all physical repairs safely.
- Professional escalation guidance only for critical or unsafe conditions.
